visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black bucket hat and a black long-sleeved shirt is squatting on a gravel ground. He uses a teal electric chainsaw to cut through a thick wooden log placed on a metal grate. His hands are protected by thick yellow work gloves as he maneuvers the tool. (2) The scene shifts to the man sitting on a small stool outdoors with a body of water in the background. He holds the electric chainsaw towards the camera, gesturing with his gloved hands while appearing to speak. The lighting is natural and diffuse under an overcast sky. (3) Close-up shots of the chainsaw cutting through the log are shown in rapid succession. Slices of wood fall onto the gravel as the blade rotates through the timber. The camera focus remains tightly on the interaction between the metal blade and the wood fibers. (4) The man is back in the sitting position, holding the chainsaw upright. He interacts with a battery pack, removing it from the tool to show it to the camera. Several circular wood slices are visible on the ground around his feet.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 電動鏈鋸好用嗎 實際測試看看 我們今天來試試看看牧田. (2) [Subtitle]: 這款牧田鏈鋸能夠鋸多少次. (3) [Subtitle]: 這款牧田電鋸型號是DUC150. (4) [Subtitle]: 鏈鋸長度是15公分. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後使用的是6ah的副廠電池. (6) [Subtitle]: 電池現在是三格電 這電池很棒 可以type c 充電. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後這款是無刷馬達的 我現在鋸一片片的 看這樣可以鋸多少片哦. (8) [Subtitle]: 3x速度. (9) [Subtitle]: 8x速度. (10) [Subtitle]: 嗯，我們現在鋸了十段木頭了 然後電量呢 現在還有兩格動力 (之後恢復三格). (11) [Subtitle]: 感覺力量也沒有衰減. (12) [Subtitle]: 看起來這樣處理好幾段的木材 一定是沒問題的. (13) [Subtitle]: 那你滿意它的效果嗎. (14) [Subtitle]: 很滿意啊 但我覺得可以考慮下買更大把. (15) [Subtitle]: 不用了 謝謝.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, sustained mechanical buzzing of an electric chainsaw motor cutting through wood. The sound has a sharp, gritty texture and a high frequency centroid. (2) A clear, male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a moderate conversational volume and a professional, informative tone. The background is mostly silent outdoor ambience. (3) The mechanical buzzing returns but at a significantly higher pitch and faster repetition rate, indicating accelerated video playback. The sound is highly percussive and rhythmic. (4) The male voice resumes speaking, providing detailed technical information. A sharp metallic click is heard as a battery is detached from the tool. (5) A female voice enters with a lighter, inquisitive tone, engaging in a brief dialogue with the male speaker. The interaction is calm and natural, ending with a short humorous dismissal from the female voice.
